base_prompt:
Create a 3:1 panoramic background for an illustrated gothic fantasy RPG, 2172x724. Pure text generation, no image reference.
Scene: SCENE_SPEC
ART DIRECTION: painterly semi-realistic game illustration with elegant soft shapes and restrained detail. Matte surfaces. Broad uninterrupted material planes carry delicate painted colour variation. Leave the surface relief almost invisible. The visual emphasis is silhouette, atmosphere and soft moonlight, rather than microtexture.
CRITICAL MATERIALS: the road is FLUSH worn limestone paving, the surface reads as a SINGLE SMOOTH PLANE. Small to medium irregular paving units are suggested ONLY by faint thin low-contrast hairline seams, NO thickness at edges, NO bevels, NO raised rims, NO dark outlines, NO individual highlighted tile edges. Fine shallow irregular cracks, subtle broad tonal patches, no tessellated rows or repeated arcs. Road is dry matte, never glossy or wet. Tree trunks have long smooth continuous tapered forms with a few faint longitudinal strokes, absolutely no chunky raised bark plates. Rock faces are broad smooth continuous stone planes with subtle mineral washes, no collections of rounded lumps. Foliage grouped into soft painterly masses, no tightly edged individual shiny leaves. Ruins use flat fitted masonry whose joints have minimal contrast. Do not apply a bumpy high-frequency texture over the scene.
COMPOSITION: elevated oblique side view, broad horizontal walkable road from left to right occupying y=.52-.80. Unobstructed and evenly wide along whole panorama. At x=.79, one short gentle right-upper branch heads to right edge y=.32-.46, while main road continues straight right at y=.59-.80. Exactly two exits; no steps, no raised ramp, no arch doorway blocking road. All ruin props behind upper road edge, foreground framing below y=.86.
LIGHT: dark desaturated blue-grey moonlight, distant scenery noticeably hazy with low edge contrast, foreground gently blurred. Sparse tiny amber lanterns, soft diffuse light with no sharp grazing highlights on tile seams. Road legible but quiet. No people, monsters, UI, letters, logo, watermark. Preserve refined painted atmosphere, do not simplify into flat vector or large polygon blocks.
